latex.caption: Retrospective DIII-D forecasting on 33 Hanson shots with offline ZIPFIT and postprocessed magnetic-RMS inputs, and unverified negative coverage. Positives precede listed $n=1$ onsets by at most 100 ms; high-$\beta$ conditions on $\beta_N\geq0.8$ shot whole-window p95; above-proxy conditions on $\beta_N/l_i>4$. Brackets: 95\% shot-bootstrap intervals (1,000 resamples), conditional on fixed fitted predictions. Five-split forest-minus-elapsed-time AUROC ranges: high-$\beta$ $-0.04$ to $0.05$; above-proxy $-0.05$ to $0.06$. The primary seed-3 lower bound is borderline near zero. Campaign 2014 high-$\beta$ AUROC is at or below chance ($0.31$ to $0.53$; reference-split CI [0.22, 0.41]) and below elapsed time on every split. Run-record holdout retains four records across three dates. Legacy uses different inputs and expert-reviewed stable shots; results are not comparable.

campaign_pairs.caption: Forest minus elapsed time by campaign. Brackets: 95\% basic paired shot-bootstrap intervals (1,000 resamples), conditional on fixed fitted predictions. High-$\beta$: $\beta_N\geq0.8$ shot p95; above-proxy: $\beta_N/l_i>4$. All five 2014 point differences are negative in both conditional strata; all five 2018 split-seed intervals include zero. Run-record holdout intervals are tabulated separately.

alarms.caption: Forest alarms across all five splits and the run-record holdout. Brackets: 95\% shot-bootstrap intervals (basic paired intervals for differences), conditional on fixed fitted predictions. No improvement over the approximate rate-matched random reference was established: all five difference intervals include zero; equivalence is not established. Warning medians condition on detected onsets. The reference-split $\beta_N$ rule warns 4/48 onsets; detection minus reference is $0.058$ {\scriptsize $[0.014, 0.115]$}. Its low detection coverage limits this result.

onset_actual.caption: Offline EFIT inputs held at the actual listed onset (last sample age $\leq50$ ms): 5 snapshots below $\beta_N/l_i=4$; 4 missing EFIT snapshots. Missing inputs retain their own category. Elapsed time starts at the first $|I_p|\geq0.5$ MA crossing. High-$\beta$ slices are counted in the 100 ms pre-onset forecast window. The pre-onset-window snapshot is distinct from the actual onset; no post-onset extent is inferred.
